description: This Java class 'ContainerLoader' manages the lifecycle of containers (background processes) in the OFBiz framework, including loading, starting, and unloading containers based on configuration and startup commands.

classes.name: ContainerLoader
classes.description: Manages loading, starting, and unloading of containers in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes and starts containers based on configuration and startup commands.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Checks if two collections have an intersection or are both empty.

methods.name: loadContainersFromConfigurations
methods.description: Loads containers matching specified loaders from configuration.

methods.name: loadContainer
methods.description: Loads and initializes a single container based on configuration.
